Sources: Ken Johnson, Ancient Prophecies Revealed (#1–485; numbers in grey) and his biblical chronology; Scripture (KJV); Dead Sea Scroll manuscripts in italic green (e.g. 1QIsa-a, the Great Isaiah Scroll; 4Q174; 11Q13).
